4.0113 Site plan requirements . (a) General requirements: Plans shall be drawn at a scale of 1" = 60' or larger (i.e. 1" = 40'). The maximum sheet size for all plans shall not exceed 24 inches by 36 inches. Multiple sheets may be used, provided each sheet is numbered, the total number of sheets is indicated on each sheet, and an overall master sheet at a smaller scale is provided. Cross - referencing between sheets shal l be required Necessary notes and symbol legends shall be included. Abbreviations should be avoided, but if used they shall be defined in the notes. All plans must be clear, readable and fully dimensioned utilizing a standard engineer scale.
